Optimizely Products Skillset

What you need to know before using our products.

Using one of the world's leading digital experience platform

Are you a developer trying to learn new skills or explore new platforms? Are you trying to build your own team to manage your instances of the Optimizely product? Or maybe you are assessing if a certain team has the required skillset to help implement an Optimizely project for you? Fear not, here is a quick overview of the different types of skillset you'll need for each of our products, from what you need for the intial setup/installation of the tool, to what you need to maintain, upgrade, customize, and to what you need on a day to day basis.

Since all our products primarily use or work with web platforms, general HTML, CSS, and JavaScript technical skills are recommended for them all. Those products that specifically need HTML, CSS, and JavaScript technical skills are highlighted below.

 

Digital Experience Platform (DXP)

Our DXP unifies the right application of content management, digital commerce, and customer intelligence to deliver customer centric experiences on every channel. Depending on the combination that you have, the skillset will vary. Please see the specific skillset requirement for the product of your solution.

 

Content Management System (CMS)

Optimizely Content Management System is a content management system and digital marketing suite. It uses artificial intelligence to deliver individualized content experiences across all of your channels.

What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

There was a major change to our code foundation between PaaS Content Management System version 11 and version 12, hence, the skillset required will have a small difference pending which version of Content Management you are using.

  • PaaS CMS 11 or earlier
    • Detailed knowledge of building and customizing websites using Optimizely Content Management 11
    • .NET Framework development with ASP.NET MVC
  • PaaS CMS 12 or later
    • Detailed knowledge of building and customizing websites using Optimizely Content Management 12
    • .NET 5 or later with ASP.NET Core MVC
  • All PaaS CMS version
    • Content Management developers involves more back-end knowledge rather than front-end, but an understanding of HTML/JavaScript/CSS will be required
    • Optional but recommended
      • Understanding of JavaScript libraries like Angular, React, and Vue
      • Understanding of HTTP/REST API
  • SaaS CMS
    • Basic domain management knowledge
    • A front-end framework of your choice
    • Graph
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required for on-going maintenance and customization.

    When upgrading, it is important to understand the difference between the old version and the new version, especially in the case of PaaS CMS 11 and PaaS CMS 12, where the foundation code has been changed to ASP.NET Core.

    When using Content Management as a business user, the skillset required will vary pending on the implemetation of the platform. However, we have training programs that will go over the common elements that are available on our platform regardless of how it is implemented:

    • Creating website content
    • Version control
    • Edit properties and page settings
    • Running reports
    • Creating content in multiple languages
    • Managing user logins and user groups
    • System configuration (settings, websites, languages, categories)
    • and more
    Useful Resources
    • PaaS Content Management System documentation
    • SaaS Content Management System documentation
    • Content Management training programs:
      • What is Content Management System (CMS)?
      • Get started with Content Management System (CMS)

     

    Configured Commerce

    Optimizely Configured Commerce provides the flexibility required to manage the complex business rules and integration needs of enterprise business-to-business (B2B) and direct-to-consumer organizations.

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
    • Front end libraries such as Angular, React, or Vue
    • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
    • Concepts of headless CMS
    • Concepts of SaaS
    • Knowledge of the eCommerce field
    • Knowledge and understanding of Git technology and command line tools
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required for on-going maintenance and customization.

    As any eCommerce platform, one of the most important aspect is the collection of data and the analysis of such data to help marketers, sales, and the tech team. With that said, our B2B Commerce has its own analytic tools for doing so, and the knowledge and understanding of how to use this tool is highly recommended.

    Useful Resources
    • Configured Commerce documentation
    • Configured Commerce training programs:
      • What is Configured Commerce?
      • What is Optimizely Product Information Management (PIM)?

     

    Commerce Connect

    Optimizely Commerce Connect is a complete digital commerce suite. It uses artificial intelligence, to deliver personalized experiences, individualized search rankings and product recommendations.

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
    • Front end libraries such as Angular, React, or Vue
    • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
    • Understanding of how to build websites using Optimizely Content Management
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required for on-going maintenance and customization.

    Useful Resources
    • Commerce Connect documentation
    • Commerce Connect training programs:
      • What is Customized Commerce?
      • Get started with Customized Commerce

     

    Web Experimentation

    Web Experimentation is a testing and optimization application. Test and optimize customer experiences such as format and messaging, which provides customer data driven preferences.

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required.

    Useful Resources
    • Web Experimentation documentation
    • Experimentation training programs:
      • What is Web Experimentation?
      • Get started with Web Experimentation
      • Strategies for experimentation

     

    Feature Experimentation

    Feature Experimentation is the experimentation and optimization platform for development applications. This maximizes the performance and outcomes of an app, (rather than web experiences, like our Web Experimentation Product).

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

    Optimizely Feature Experimentation comes with SDK in many programming languages. Depending on the language your existing platform uses, the required skillset will vary.

    We have the following SDK available to you:

    • Android
    • C#
    • Go
    • Java
    • JavaScript (Browser)
    • JavaScript (Node)
    • Objective-C
    • PHP
    • Phython
    • React
    • React Native
    • Ruby
    • Swift
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required.

    Useful Resources
    • Feature Experimentation documentation
      • SDK reference guides
      • SDK compatibility matrix
    • Experimentation training programs:
      • What is Feature Experimentation?
      • Get started with Feature Experimentation

     

    Data Platform

    Data-driven marketing teams use Optimizely Data Platform to align their entire brand around the customer experience. Harmonize customer data across the Digital Experience Platform and the broader ecosystem. Gather a unified understanding of the customer context. Use powerful integrations to activate customer data with the right message at the right time during the customer journey.

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

    The skillset require for setting up and installing ODP will depend on which platform you integrate with. Most of the configuration can be done within the ODP portal, however, there are cases where knowledge and understanding of HTML/JavaScript is required to properly embed the ODP tag to complete the integration. See documentation for complete list of integration instructions.

    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    Maintenance and upgrade of the platform will be managed by Optimizely.

    To fully utilize the data from ODP, understanding the concept of building complex Excel spreadsheet will help you configure custom filters, behaviors, segments, reports, and campaigns.

    Useful Resources
    • ODP documentation
    • Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using ODP
      • Technical onboarding
      • User onboarding

    Connect Platform

    The Optimizely Connect Platform makes it easy for marketers to compose digital experiences with pre-built connectors to their most important marketing tools and sources of customer data. The platform also makes it easy for developers to build new connectors that simplify the jobs of data ingest and channel activation, allowing them to easily extend connectivity to any marketing suite.

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

    OCP applications are single click installations for the end user. Typically, the user will need to provide identity and authentication information, such as account information and API keys. No further technical skill is required for the installation of OCP apps.

    OCP apps are built on the Node.js framework, and require JavaScript and TypeScript development ability to build an app.

    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    None.  OCP is a fully managed environment provided by Optimizely, and all aspects of running and scaling apps is automatically provided. If your app requires updates, such as expanded functionality, then the same skills required to build the app can be used for your updates.

    Useful Resources
    • OCP documentation
    • Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using OCP
      • Technical onboarding
      • User onboarding

     

    Recommendations

    Provide best-next personalization at scale. Optimizely's Recommendations suite provides brands with a composable, always-on, predictive analytics engine to drive more revenue and deepen relationships. Custom-tailored to accelerate your business, the proper selection from Optimizely's 95+ personalization algorithms turn people's actions into actionable insights you can use to unlock continuous innovation at every step of the customer journey.

      Content Recommendations and Intelligence
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • For use on Optimizely Content Cloud websites
      • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript
        • Required for adding attributes to DOM objects
      • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
        • Required for installing NuGet package to the solution only
      • Understanding of OpenGraph tags
      • Understanding of Optimizely tag attributes
    • For use on non-Optimizely Content Cloud websites
      • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
        • For customizing the display of content recommendations through the portal
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?
    • Understanding of data analysis
      • Required to analyze the Content Intelligence reports
    Useful Resources
    • Personalization documentation
    • Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using our recommendation products
      Email Content Recommendation
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Same as Content Recommendations & Intelligence (uses same tracking)
    • Understanding of recommendation block configuration
      • Required to generate emails
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
      • Required for customizing email templates
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    After everything is setup, the ongoing day to day usage will be done within the portal. An understanding of how Optimizely Email Reommendations work, how to create/manage campaigns, and how to create/manage product sets is required.

    Useful Resources

    Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using our recommendation products.

      Product Recommendation
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript
      • Required for adding attributes to DOM objects
    • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
      • Required for installing NuGet package to the solution only
    • Understanding of OpenGraph tags
    • Understanding of Optimizely tag attributes
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    After everything is setup, the ongoing day to day usage will be done within the portal. An understanding of how Optimizely Product Reommendations work, how to create/manage campaigns, how to perform a campaign review, and how to create/manage product sets is required.

    Useful Resources
    • Personalization documentation
    • Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using our recommendation products
      Email Product Recommendation
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Same as Product Recommendations (uses same tracking)
    • Understanding of recommendation block configuration
      • Required to generate emails
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript/CSS
      • Required for customizing email templates
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    After everything is setup, the ongoing day to day usage will be done within the portal. An understanding of how Optimizely Email Reommendations work, how to create/manage campaigns, and how to create/manage product sets is required.

    Useful Resources

    Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager on details for getting training on using our recommendation products.

    More Products

    • Knowledge of marketing principles, techniques, and media

    • DNS management
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    For marketers/business users:

    For developers/administrators:

    • Marketing Automation documentation
      Search & Navigation
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    The same skillset as the initial setup/installation is required for maintenance, upgrade, and customization.

    For ongoing day to day usage, and understanding of managing features like field boosting, best bets, related queries, and so on through the portal is required.

    Useful Resources

    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Front end web development such as HTML/JavaScript

    • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
    • Understanding of OpenGraph tags
    • Understanding of Optimizely tag attributes
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    Useful Resources

      Commerce Analytics
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

    Commerce Analytics is a tool available for B2B Commerce Cloud. Once an account is created and activated, you'll be able to access it through a website.

    There are some generic skillset that's recommended before using the tool, and also some specific ones for certain scenario.

    For partner hosted instances:

    • The ability to export data and send it to a location defined by Optimizely
    • The ability to work with the SQL files sent by Optimizely

    For cloud-hosted instances and order history not loaded into B2B Commerce Cloud:

    • The ability to export data and send it to a location defined by Optimizely
    • The ability to customize setup if needed

    Overall skills recommended:

    • Familiarity of basic analytics such as Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager
    • Previous experience working with eCommerce data analysis
    • Previous experience working with data analysis tools such as Microsoft Excel (pivot table) and SQL
    • Familiarity of eCommerce components and processes such as:
      • Order history
      • Customer data
      • Customer groups
      • Product groups
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?
    • Ability to analyze and/or read generated reports from the Commerce Analytics dashboard
    • Ability to configure Commerce Analytics settings that affects data reporting 
    Useful Resources
    • Commerce Analytics user guide
      Product Information Management (PIM)
    What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?
    • Knowledge of marketing principles, techniques, and media
    • Knowledge of eCommerce components and processes such as:
      • Orders
      • Customers
    • Knowledge of Product Information Management (PIM)
    • Ability to follow the steps required for PIM implementation such as:
      • Ability to identify the PIM team including roles and permissions
      • Ability to keep the data clean for import to PIM
      • Ability to configure settings required in PIM 
    • For integration with Optimizely B2C Commerce Cloud
      • .NET development with ASP.NET MVC
        • Required for installing NuGet package to the solution only
      • Developer's completion of Optimizely B2C Commerce Developer learning path or equivalent knowledge
    What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

    For commerce business users and administrators:

    • Understanding of product managment in Optimizely B2C Commerce Cloud

    For developers:

    • Ability to setup and maintain 3rd party integrations with PIM using the available ready-only APIs
    Useful Resources
    • PIM documentation on integration
    • PIM user guide

See [documentation](https://docs.zaius.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001267634-Integrations) for complete list of integration instructions.

##### What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

Maintenance and upgrade of the platform will be managed by Optimizely.

To fully utilize the data from ODP, understanding the concept of building complex Excel spreadsheet will help you configure custom filters, behaviors, segments, reports, and campaigns.

## Connect Platform

The Optimizely Connect Platform makes it easy for marketers to compose digital experiences with pre-built connectors to their most important marketing tools and sources of customer data. The platform also makes it easy for developers to build new connectors that simplify the jobs of data ingest and channel activation, allowing them to easily extend connectivity to any marketing suite.

##### What technical skill is required for the initial setup/installation of the product?

OCP applications are single click installations for the end user. Typically, the user will need to provide identity and authentication information, such as account information and API keys. No further technical skill is required for the installation of OCP apps.

OCP apps are built on the Node.js framework, and require JavaScript and TypeScript development ability to build an app.

##### What technical skill is required for post launch (maintenance, upgrade, customization, daily use)?

None.  OCP is a fully managed environment provided by Optimizely, and all aspects of running and scaling apps is automatically provided. If your app requires updates, such as expanded functionality, then the same skills required to build the app can be used for your updates.
